## Set-up

```{r}
#| label: base parameters
#| cache: false

# ── Baseline parameter set ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# All sensitivity runs keep every parameter at these values except the focal one.
baseline <- modifyList(base_params, list(A_cold = 1.0, A_warm = 0, pcmax_cold = 0.5, pcmax_warm = 0.5, nyears_burnin = 10, nyears_experiment = 20, save_burnin = TRUE))

exp_start_date <- as.Date(baseline$mindate) + lubridate::years(baseline$nyears_burnin)
burn_start     <- year(as.Date(baseline$mindate))
exp_start_yr   <- year(exp_start_date)
exp_end_yr     <- exp_start_yr + baseline$nyears_experiment

cat("Baseline parameters:\n")
# cat("  Sensitivity to growth differences:    tau                      :", baseline$tau, "\n")
cat("  Strenth of density dependence:        K_cold / K_warm          :", baseline$K_cold, "/", baseline$K_warm, "\n")
cat("  Egg survival rate:                    egg_surv                 :", baseline$egg_surv, "\n")
cat("  Size-based dominance:                 dominance_beta           :", baseline$dominance_beta, "\n")
cat("  Maximum p-value:                      pcmax_cold/ pcmax_warm   :", baseline$pcmax_cold, "/", baseline$pcmax_warm, "\n")
cat("  Habitat area:                         A_cold / A_warm          :", baseline$A_cold, "/", baseline$A_warm, "\n")
cat("  Min. size-based daily survival prob:  s_min                    :", baseline$s_min, "\n")
cat("  Size-based survival inflection point: s_w0                     :", baseline$s_w0, "\n")
cat("  Condition-based survival inflection:  K1_starv / K9_starv      :", baseline$K1_starv, "/", baseline$K9_starv, "\n")
cat("  Condition-based survival floor:       s_floor_starv            :", baseline$s_floor_starv, "\n")
cat("  Max. daily survival prob:             S_max_cold / S_max_warm  :", baseline$S_max_cold, "/", baseline$S_max_warm,"\n")

cat("Short model runs for efficiency: Burn-in = ", burn_start, "–", exp_start_yr - 1,
    ", Experiment = ", exp_start_yr, "–", exp_end_yr, "\n")
```


```{r}
#| label: helpers
#| cache: false

# ── Helper: run one sensitivity simulation ─────────────────────────────────────
run_sens <- function(param_name, param_val, base = baseline) {
  p   <- modifyList(base, setNames(list(param_val), param_name))
  # K must be set in both habitat and params
  if (param_name %in% c("K_cold", "K_warm")) {
    p <- modifyList(p, list(K_cold = param_val, K_warm = param_val))
  }
  hdf <- build_habitat(p)
  run_simulation(habitat_df = hdf, params = p, wt_growth = wt.growth)
}

# ── Helper: Oct 1 annual census (N and total biomass) ─────────────────────────
oct1_census <- function(sim, label) {
  sim$ibm_long |>
    filter(!is.na(date), survived == 1,
           month(date) == 10, day(date) == 1) |>
    mutate(year  = year(date),
           phase = if_else(year < exp_start_yr, "burn-in", "experiment")) |>
    # filter(phase = "experiment") |>
    group_by(year, phase) |>
    summarise(N        = n_distinct(pid),
              biomass_kg = sum(weight) / 1000,
              .groups  = "drop") |>
    mutate(label = label)
}

# ── Helper: population map (burn-in N[t+1] ~ N[t]) ───────────────────────────
pop_map <- function(census_df) {
  census_df |>
    # filter(phase == "burn-in") |>
    group_by(label) |>
    arrange(year) |>
    mutate(N_next = lead(N)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(!is.na(N_next))
}

# ── Helper: stock-recruitment (60-day survivor biomass vs spawner biomass) ─────
# Uses total biomass of fry on their 60th day of life as the recruitment metric.
# Biomass captures both the mortality effect (fewer survivors at high density)
# and the growth effect (survivors are lighter at high density due to food
# competition), giving a more complete picture of density-dependent compensation
# under the sigmoid fncSurviveSize than abundance alone would.
stock_recruit <- function(sim, label) {
  ibm <- sim$ibm_long
  hdf <- sim$habitat_df

  # Total biomass of fry on exactly their 60th day of life
  recruits_60d <- ibm |>
    filter(!is.na(parent_pid), !is.na(birth_dayofsim)) |>
    mutate(birth_yr    = year(hdf$date[birth_dayofsim]),
           day_of_life = dayofsim - birth_dayofsim) |>
    filter(#birth_yr < exp_start_yr, 
           day_of_life == 60) |>
    group_by(birth_yr) |>
    summarise(abun_surv60 = n(),
              bio_surv60_kg = sum(weight) / 1000, .groups = "drop")

  # Spawner biomass: adults (≥ 100 g) present during spawning window (Apr–Jun)
  spawner_bio <- ibm |>
    filter(!is.na(date), survived == 1) |>
    mutate(year = year(date), doy = yday(date)) |>
    filter(#year < exp_start_yr,
           doy >= 90, doy <= 150, weight >= 100) |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarise(spawner_kg = sum(weight) / 1000, .groups = "drop")

  left_join(recruits_60d, spawner_bio, by = c("birth_yr" = "year")) |>
    mutate(label = label, spawner_kg = replace_na(spawner_kg, 0))
}

# ── Helper: size-based early thinning rate vs cohort size ─────────────────────
thinning_rate <- function(sim, label) {
  ibm <- sim$ibm_long
  hdf <- sim$habitat_df

  born <- ibm |>
    filter(!is.na(parent_pid)) |>
    mutate(birth_yr = year(hdf$date[birth_dayofsim])) |>
    # filter(birth_yr < exp_start_yr) |>
    distinct(pid, birth_yr) |>
    count(birth_yr, name = "n_born")

  surv60 <- ibm |>
    filter(!is.na(parent_pid)) |>
    mutate(birth_yr = year(hdf$date[birth_dayofsim])) |>
    # filter(birth_yr < exp_start_yr) |>
    group_by(pid, birth_yr) |>
    summarise(days_alive = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(days_alive >= 60) |>
    count(birth_yr, name = "n_surv60")

  left_join(born, surv60, by = "birth_yr") |>
    mutate(surv_rate = replace_na(n_surv60 / n_born, 0),
           label = label)
}

# ── Helper: density–age-0 growth relationship (Aug 1 weight vs July density) ──
age0_density_growth <- function(sim, label) {
  ibm <- sim$ibm_long

  # Mean daily July abundance (all fish, all ages) per burn-in year
  july_dens <- ibm |>
    filter(# year(date) < exp_start_yr,
           !is.na(date), survived == 1, month(date) == 7
           ) |>
    group_by(year = year(date), date) |>
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarise(mean_july_n = mean(n), .groups = "drop")

  # Mean age-0 weight at Aug 1 (DOY 213) per burn-in cohort
  aug1_wt <- ibm |>
    filter(#year(date) < exp_start_yr,
           !is.na(date), survived == 1, !is.na(ggd),
           yday(date) == 213) |>
    mutate(year = year(date)) |>
    filter(cohort == year) |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarise(mean_wt = mean(weight), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(n >= 5)

  left_join(aug1_wt, july_dens, by = "year") |>
    mutate(label = label)
}

# ── Helper: weight-at-age (Oct 1, experiment mean, ages 0-14) ────────────────────
wt_at_age <- function(sim, label) {
  sim$ibm_long |>
    filter(!is.na(date), survived == 1,
           month(date) == 10, day(date) == 1) |>
    mutate(year     = year(date),
           age_yrs  = floor(age),
           phase    = if_else(year < exp_start_yr, "burn-in", "experiment")) |>
    filter(phase == "experiment", age_yrs <= 14) |>
    group_by(age_yrs) |>
    summarise(mean_wt = mean(weight), sd_wt = sd(weight), n = n_distinct(pid), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(n >= 5) |>
    # group_by(age_yrs) |>
    # summarise(mean_wt = mean(mean_wt), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(label = label)
}

# ── Helper: age-0 daily weight (doy mean across experiment cohorts) ──────────────
age0_daily_wt <- function(sim, label) {
  exp_fish <- sim$ibm_long |>
    filter(floor(age) == 0, !is.na(date), survived == 1, !is.na(ggd),
           cohort >= exp_start_yr)

  # Population may collapse before the experimental period (e.g. extreme s_w0)
  if (nrow(exp_fish) == 0L) {
    return(tibble(date = as.Date(character()), mean_wt = numeric(),
                  sd_wt = numeric(), n = integer(), label = character()))
  }

  exp_fish |>
    mutate(days_from_may1 = as.integer(date - as.Date(paste0(as.integer(cohort), "-05-01")))) |>
    filter(days_from_may1 >= 0, days_from_may1 < 365) |>
    # Anchor all cohorts to a common reference year for plotting
    mutate(date = as.Date("2000-05-01") + days_from_may1) |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarise(mean_wt = mean(weight),
              sd_wt   = sd(weight),
              n       = n(),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(n >= 5) |>
    mutate(label = label)
}

# ── Population summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
population_stats <- function(census_df) {
  census_df |>
    group_by(label, phase) |>
    summarise(mean_N     = mean(N),
              sd_N       = sd(N),
              mean_bio   = mean(biomass_kg),
              sd_bio     = sd(biomass_kg),
              sim_yrs    = n(),
              .groups    = "drop")
}

# ── Total years simulated (burn-in + experiment combined) ─────────────────────
# Used in the cross-parameter summary to identify premature collapse.
# max possible = nyears_burnin + nyears_experiment = 100.
total_sim_yrs <- function(census_df) {
  census_df |>
    group_by(label) |>
    summarise(total_yrs = n_distinct(year), .groups = "drop")
}

# ── Helper: 2-panel stability figure (mean N and mean biomass, experiment only) ─
# pop_df: output of population_stats(); cols: length-3 colour vector.
# Layout: two panels side by side — abundance (left) and biomass (right).
plot_stability_fig <- function(pop_df, cols) {
  exp_df <- pop_df |>
    filter(phase == "experiment") |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols      = c(mean_N, mean_bio),
      names_to  = "metric",
      values_to = "mean"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      sd = if_else(metric == "mean_N", sd_N, sd_bio),
      metric = factor(metric,
                      levels = c("mean_N", "mean_bio"),
                      labels = c("Mean abundance (Oct 1)", "Mean biomass (kg)"))
    )

  ggplot(exp_df, aes(x = label, y = mean, fill = label)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean - sd, 0), ymax = mean + sd),
                  width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_sens() +
    theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7.5, lineheight = 0.85),
          strip.text   = element_text(size = 9),
          panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines"))
}

# ── Helper: days post-hatch until cohort-mean weight first exceeds s_w0 ───────
# Reads s_w0 from sim$params so it works for any parameter section:
# — non-s_w0 sections: all sims share the baseline s_w0 (one threshold line)
# — s_w0 section: each sim has its own s_w0 (three threshold lines)
days_to_threshold <- function(sim, label) {
  ibm    <- sim$ibm_long
  hdf    <- sim$habitat_df
  w0_val <- sim$params$s_w0

  cohort_wt <- ibm |>
    filter(#year(date) < exp_start_yr,
           !is.na(date), survived == 1, !is.na(ggd)) |>
    mutate(doy = yday(date)) |>
    filter(cohort == year(date)) |>
    group_by(cohort, doy) |>
    summarise(mean_wt = mean(weight), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(n >= 5)

  threshold_doy <- cohort_wt |>
    group_by(cohort) |>
    summarise(
      hatch_doy   = min(doy),
      cross_doy   = doy[which(mean_wt >= w0_val)[1]],
      .groups     = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(days_to_cross = cross_doy - hatch_doy)

  fry_born <- sim$spawn_log |>
    left_join(hdf |> select(dayofsim, date), by = "dayofsim") |>
    filter(#year(date) < exp_start_yr,
           !is.na(date)) |>
    mutate(cohort = year(date)) |>
    group_by(cohort) |>
    summarise(n_born = sum(n_offspring), .groups = "drop")

  left_join(threshold_doy, fry_born, by = "cohort") |>
    filter(!is.na(days_to_cross), !is.na(n_born)) |>
    mutate(label = label, w0 = w0_val)
}

# ── Helper: scatter + OLS plot of days-to-threshold vs fry born ───────────────
plot_danger_duration <- function(cross_df, cols) {
  slope_labs <- cross_df |>
    group_by(label, w0) |>
    summarise(
      slope = coef(lm(days_to_cross ~ n_born))[["n_born"]] * 1000,
      r_sq  = summary(lm(days_to_cross ~ n_born))$r.squared,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(w0) |>
    mutate(
      x   = max(cross_df$n_born, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.97,
      y   = seq(
        from       = quantile(cross_df$days_to_cross, 0.38, na.rm = TRUE),
        by         = diff(range(cross_df$days_to_cross, na.rm = TRUE)) * 0.15,
        length.out = n()
      ),
      txt = paste0("+", round(slope, 1), " d / 1000 fry  (R\u00b2 = ", round(r_sq, 2), ")")
    )

  ggplot(cross_df, aes(x = n_born, y = days_to_cross, color = label)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.12) +
    # geom_text(data = slope_labs,
    #           aes(x = x, y = y, label = txt, color = label),
    #           hjust = 1, size = 2.8, fontface = "italic", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(x     = "Fry born (cohort size)",
         y     = "Days post-hatch to exceed s_w0",
         color = NULL,
         title = "Density extends the low-survival window") +
    theme_sens()
}

# ── Helper: age at first reproduction ────────────────────────────────────────
# For each parent, find their first spawn event (min dayofsim), join to ibm_long
# to get age at that moment, then summarise mean and SD across all spawners
# in the experimental period.
spawn_afr <- function(sim, label) {
  hdf <- sim$habitat_df |> select(dayofsim, date)

  sim$spawn_log |>
    group_by(parent_pid) |>
    summarise(first_dayofsim = min(dayofsim), .groups = "drop") |>
    left_join(hdf, by = c("first_dayofsim" = "dayofsim")) |>
    filter(year(date) >= exp_start_yr) |>
    left_join(sim$ibm_long |> select(pid, dayofsim, age),
              by = c("parent_pid" = "pid", "first_dayofsim" = "dayofsim")) |>
    summarise(mean_afr = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_afr   = sd(age,   na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    mutate(label = label)
}

# ── Helper: annual spawning participation rate ────────────────────────────────
# Unique spawners per year (from spawn_log) divided by Oct 1 population size
# of the preceding year. Summarises mean and SD of participation across years.
spawn_participation <- function(sim, label) {
  hdf <- sim$habitat_df |> select(dayofsim, date)

  spawners_yr <- sim$spawn_log |>
    left_join(hdf, by = "dayofsim") |>
    filter(year(date) >= exp_start_yr) |>
    mutate(year = year(date)) |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarise(n_spawners = n_distinct(parent_pid), .groups = "drop")

  # Oct 1 N from prior year provides the denominator
  oct1_N <- sim$ibm_long |>
    filter(survived == 1, month(date) == 10, day(date) == 1,
           year(date) >= exp_start_yr - 1L) |>
    group_by(year = year(date)) |>
    summarise(N = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(year = year + 1L)   # shift to match the following spring's spawners

  spawners_yr |>
    left_join(oct1_N, by = "year") |>
    mutate(participation = n_spawners / N) |>
    summarise(mean_part = mean(participation, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_part   = sd(participation,   na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    mutate(label = label)
}

# ── Helper: repeat spawning prevalence ────────────────────────────────────────
# For each year in the experimental period, calculates the fraction of that
# year's spawners who also spawned in at least one prior year. Returns the mean
# and SD of this annual fraction across experimental years.
repeat_spawning <- function(sim, label) {
  hdf <- sim$habitat_df |> select(dayofsim, date)

  spawn_with_date <- sim$spawn_log |>
    left_join(hdf, by = "dayofsim") |>
    mutate(year = year(date))

  # all spawn-years per fish (whole simulation, to catch pre-exp-period history)
  prior_yrs <- spawn_with_date |>
    group_by(parent_pid) |>
    summarise(all_years = list(sort(unique(year))), .groups = "drop")

  exp_years <- sort(unique(spawn_with_date$year[spawn_with_date$year >= exp_start_yr]))

  yr_stats <- map_dfr(exp_years, function(yr) {
    spawners_yr <- spawn_with_date |>
      filter(year == yr) |>
      distinct(parent_pid) |>
      left_join(prior_yrs, by = "parent_pid") |>
      mutate(is_repeat = map_lgl(all_years, ~ any(.x < yr)))
    tibble(year = yr, pct_repeat = 100 * mean(spawners_yr$is_repeat))
  })

  if (nrow(yr_stats) == 0) {
    return(tibble(mean_pct_repeat = NA_real_, sd_pct_repeat = NA_real_, label = label))
  }

  yr_stats |>
    summarise(mean_pct_repeat = mean(pct_repeat),
              sd_pct_repeat   = sd(pct_repeat)) |>
    mutate(label = label)
}

# ── Helper: recruitment indices (age-0 Oct 1 and age-1 Jun 1) ─────────────────
# Tracks the same cohort: age-0 count at Oct 1 of the hatch year, and
# age-1 count at Jun 1 of the following year (integer age turns 1 in late Apr).
recruit_indices <- function(sim, label) {
  age0_oct1 <- sim$ibm_long |>
    filter(survived == 1, month(date) == 10, day(date) == 1,
           year(date) >= exp_start_yr, floor(age) == 0) |>
    group_by(cohort) |>
    summarise(n_age0 = n(), .groups = "drop")

  age1_jun1 <- sim$ibm_long |>
    filter(survived == 1, month(date) == 6, day(date) == 1,
           year(date) > exp_start_yr, floor(age) == 1) |>
    group_by(cohort) |>
    summarise(n_age1 = n(), .groups = "drop")

  age0_oct1 |>
    left_join(age1_jun1, by = "cohort") |>
    summarise(mean_age0_oct1 = mean(n_age0, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_age0_oct1   = sd(n_age0,   na.rm = TRUE),
              mean_age1_jun1 = mean(n_age1, na.rm = TRUE),
              sd_age1_jun1   = sd(n_age1,   na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    mutate(label = label)
}

# ── Helper: mean minimum condition by integer age class ───────────────────────
# For each individual × age class, finds the single lowest condition value
# recorded during the experimental period, then summarises the mean and SD of
# those per-individual minima across all fish in that age class.
min_condition_by_age <- function(sim, label) {
  sim$ibm_long |>
    filter(!is.na(date), survived == 1, !is.na(condition),
           year(date) >= exp_start_yr) |>
    mutate(age_class = floor(age)) |>
    group_by(pid, age_class) |>
    summarise(min_cond = min(condition), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(age_class) |>
    summarise(mean_min_cond = mean(min_cond),
              sd_min_cond   = sd(min_cond),
              n             = n(),
              .groups       = "drop") |>
    mutate(label = label)
}

# ── Helper: mean and maximum age and weight from Oct 1 census snapshot ────────
# Filters to Oct 1 survivors during the experimental period, then summarises
# mean and max age and weight across all individuals × years.
age_growth_stats <- function(sim, label) {
  sim$ibm_long |>
    filter(!is.na(date), survived == 1,
           month(date) == 10, day(date) == 1,
           year(date) >= exp_start_yr) |>
    summarise(mean_age = mean(age),
              q95_age  = quantile(age, probs = 0.95),
              mean_wt  = mean(weight),
              q95_wt   = quantile(weight, probs = 0.95)) |>
    mutate(label = label)
}

# ── Helper: simple bar chart with error bars ──────────────────────────────────
# df must have columns: label, mean, sd. cols: named colour vector.
simple_bar <- function(df, ylab, title, cols) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = label, y = mean, fill = label)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean - sd, 0), ymax = mean + sd),
                  width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab, title = title,
         subtitle = "Mean \u00b1 SD across years") +
    theme_sens()
}

# ── Shared colour palette (Okabe-Ito: blue / teal / vermillion) ──────────────
# Colorblind-friendly; all three are clearly distinguishable.
# Mapping: low value = blue, mid/baseline value = teal, high value = vermillion.
sens_cols <- c("#0072B2", "#009E73", "#D55E00")

# ── Shared plot theme ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
theme_sens <- function() {
  theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position  = "top",
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey88"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.title       = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey30"))
}
```

## `K_cold`: strength of density dependence

The half-saturation constant K controls the density at which consumption suppression
becomes binding. Smaller K creates stronger suppression at lower densities; larger K
allows the population to grow more before density effects manifest.

```{r}
#| label: sim-K
#| cache: false

K_vals   <- c(300, 400, 500)
K_labels <- paste0("K = ", K_vals)
K_cols   <- sens_cols

cache_file <- "cache/K_sims.rds"
if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  cat("Loading K simulations from cache...\n")
  K_sims <- readRDS(cache_file)
} else {
  cat("Running K sensitivity simulations...\n")
  K_sims <- lapply(seq_along(K_vals), function(i) {
    cat(" K =", K_vals[i], "... ")
    p   <- modifyList(baseline, list(K_cold = K_vals[i], K_warm = K_vals[i]))
    hdf <- build_habitat(p)
    res <- run_simulation(hdf, p, wt_growth = wt.growth)
    cat("ends", format(max(res$ibm_long$date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
    res
  })
  names(K_sims) <- K_labels
  dir.create("cache", showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(K_sims, cache_file)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: K-outcomes

K_census   <- bind_rows(Map(oct1_census,   K_sims, K_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = K_labels))
K_sr       <- bind_rows(Map(stock_recruit, K_sims, K_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = K_labels))
K_thin     <- bind_rows(Map(thinning_rate,        K_sims, K_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = K_labels))
K_dg       <- bind_rows(Map(age0_density_growth, K_sims, K_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = K_labels))
K_waa      <- bind_rows(Map(wt_at_age,     K_sims, K_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = K_labels))
K_age0_dly <- bind_rows(Map(age0_daily_wt, K_sims, K_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = K_labels))
K_ag       <- bind_rows(Map(age_growth_stats,      K_sims, K_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = K_labels))
K_mincond  <- bind_rows(Map(min_condition_by_age,  K_sims, K_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = K_labels))
K_afr      <- bind_rows(Map(spawn_afr,             K_sims, K_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = K_labels))
K_part     <- bind_rows(Map(spawn_participation,   K_sims, K_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = K_labels))
K_rec      <- bind_rows(Map(recruit_indices,        K_sims, K_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = K_labels))
K_repeat   <- bind_rows(Map(repeat_spawning,        K_sims, K_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = K_labels))
K_stable   <- population_stats(K_census)
```

### Compensatory dynamics

```{r}
#| label: fig-K-comp
#| fig-cap: "Top-left: burn-in population map. Top-right: stock-recruitment relationship. Bottom-left: size-based early thinning (% of fry surviving to day 60). Bottom-right: density–growth relationship (age-0 weight at Aug 1 vs July abundance). The bottom row together shows the two pathways of size-based density-dependent compensation: cohort thinning (left) and growth suppression (right)."
#| fig-height: 8

K_map <- pop_map(K_census)

p_map <- ggplot(K_map, aes(x = N, y = N_next, color = label)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, span = 0.75, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = K_cols) +
  labs(x = "N (year t, Oct 1)", y = "N (year t+1, Oct 1)", color = NULL,
       title = "Population map (burn-in)",
       subtitle = "Curve crossing below dashed line = compensatory") +
  theme_sens() + theme(legend.position = "none")

p_sr <- ggplot(K_sr |> filter(spawner_kg > 0),
               aes(x = spawner_kg, y = bio_surv60_kg, color = label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, span = 0.7, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = K_cols) +
  labs(x = "Spawner biomass (kg, Apr–Jun)", y = "Fry biomass at 60 days (kg)",
       color = NULL, title = "Stock-recruitment",
       subtitle = "60-day survivor biomass vs. spawner biomass \n— should show B-H plateau") +
  theme_sens() + theme(legend.position = "right")

p_thin <- ggplot(K_thin, aes(x = n_born, y = surv_rate, color = label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, span = 0.7, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = K_cols) +
  labs(x = "Fry born", y = "% of fry surviving to day 60",
       color = NULL, title = "Size-based thinning",
       subtitle = "Declining rate = density-dependent compensation") +
  theme_sens() + theme(legend.position = "none")

p_dg <- ggplot(K_dg, aes(x = mean_july_n, y = mean_wt, color = label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 7, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = K_cols) +
  labs(x = "Mean July N (all fish)", y = "Age-0 weight at Aug 1 (g)", color = NULL,
       title = "Density\u2013growth relationship",
       subtitle = "Higher density = slower early growth = more time below w\u2080") +
  theme_sens() + theme(legend.position = "none")

(p_map | p_sr) / (p_thin | p_dg)
```

## `egg_surv`: proportional egg survival

Egg-to-fry survival scales the number of recruits entering the simulation each spring.
It represents spawning habitat quality, redd conditions, and egg-incubation success.

```{r}
#| label: sim-egg
#| cache: false

egg_vals   <- c(0.01, 0.1, 0.2)
egg_labels <- paste0("egg_surv = ", egg_vals)
egg_cols   <- sens_cols

cache_file <- "cache/egg_sims.rds"
if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  cat("Loading egg_surv simulations from cache...\n")
  egg_sims <- readRDS(cache_file)
} else {
  cat("Running egg_surv sensitivity simulations...\n")
  egg_sims <- lapply(seq_along(egg_vals), function(i) {
    cat(" egg_surv =", egg_vals[i], "... ")
    p   <- modifyList(baseline, list(egg_surv = egg_vals[i]))
    hdf <- build_habitat(p)
    res <- run_simulation(hdf, p, wt_growth = wt.growth)
    cat("ends", format(max(res$ibm_long$date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
    res
  })
  names(egg_sims) <- egg_labels
  dir.create("cache", showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(egg_sims, cache_file)
}
```

```{r}
egg_ag       <- bind_rows(Map(age_growth_stats,    egg_sims, egg_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = egg_labels))
egg_mincond  <- bind_rows(Map(min_condition_by_age, egg_sims, egg_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = egg_labels))
```

## `dominance_beta`: size-based competitive dominance

`dominance_beta` controls the strength of size-based competitive dominance *within*
each age class. β = 0 is pure scramble (all fish experience the same effective density
regardless of size); β = 1 means a fish twice the size of its competitor imposes a full
competitive unit of pressure, while a fish half its size imposes only half a unit.

*Note that we run these simulations with* `pcmax_cold = 0.7`. *When food is more limiting (e.g.,* `pcmax_cold = 0.5` *), fish do not have enough growth capacity to create the "runaway" effect on weight-at-age. We increase* `pcmax_cold` *here to illustrate how fish can "escape" density dependence under higher consumption conditions.* 

```{r}
#| label: sim-beta
#| cache: false

beta_vals   <- c(0, 0.5, 1)
beta_labels <- paste0("β = ", beta_vals)
beta_cols   <- sens_cols

cache_file <- "cache/beta_sims.rds"
if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  cat("Loading dominance_beta simulations from cache...\n")
  beta_sims <- readRDS(cache_file)
} else {
  cat("Running dominance_beta sensitivity simulations...\n")
  beta_sims <- lapply(seq_along(beta_vals), function(i) {
    cat(" beta =", beta_vals[i], "... ")
    p   <- modifyList(baseline, list(dominance_beta = beta_vals[i], pcmax_cold = 0.7))
    hdf <- build_habitat(p)
    res <- run_simulation(hdf, p, wt_growth = wt.growth)
    cat("ends", format(max(res$ibm_long$date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
    res
  })
  names(beta_sims) <- beta_labels
  dir.create("cache", showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(beta_sims, cache_file)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: beta-outcomes

beta_census   <- bind_rows(Map(oct1_census,   beta_sims, beta_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = beta_labels))
beta_sr       <- bind_rows(Map(stock_recruit, beta_sims, beta_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = beta_labels))
beta_thin     <- bind_rows(Map(thinning_rate,        beta_sims, beta_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = beta_labels))
beta_dg       <- bind_rows(Map(age0_density_growth, beta_sims, beta_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = beta_labels))
beta_waa      <- bind_rows(Map(wt_at_age,     beta_sims, beta_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = beta_labels))
beta_age0_dly <- bind_rows(Map(age0_daily_wt, beta_sims, beta_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = beta_labels))
beta_ag       <- bind_rows(Map(age_growth_stats,    beta_sims, beta_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = beta_labels))
beta_mincond  <- bind_rows(Map(min_condition_by_age, beta_sims, beta_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = beta_labels))
beta_afr      <- bind_rows(Map(spawn_afr,            beta_sims, beta_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = beta_labels))
beta_part     <- bind_rows(Map(spawn_participation,  beta_sims, beta_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = beta_labels))
beta_rec      <- bind_rows(Map(recruit_indices,       beta_sims, beta_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = beta_labels))
beta_repeat   <- bind_rows(Map(repeat_spawning,       beta_sims, beta_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = beta_labels))
beta_stable   <- population_stats(beta_census)
```

## `s_min`: size-survival floor (`minprob`)

`s_min` is the daily survival probability approached by the smallest fish (weight → 0).
It sets the intensity of early-life mortality for fish that have not yet grown past the
sigmoid inflection weight `s_w0`. Elliott (1993) reports ~6.4% daily mortality during
the early critical period for brown trout (`s_min ≈ 0.936`). Lower `s_min` strengthens
size-based thinning; higher `s_min` weakens it, reducing the compensatory effect of
density-dependent growth suppression.

| Scenario | `s_min` | Daily mortality floor | Worst-case 60-day survival at 0.5g |
|---|---|---|---|
| Low | 0.94 | 6% | 2.5% |
| **Baseline** | **0.96** | **4%** | **9%** |
| High | 0.98 | 2% | 30% |

All other parameters held at baseline.

```{r}
#| label: sim-s_min
#| cache: false

s_min_vals   <- c(0.94, 0.96, 0.98)
s_min_labels <- paste0("s_min = ", s_min_vals)
s_min_cols   <- sens_cols

cache_file <- "cache/s_min_sims.rds"
if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  cat("Loading s_min simulations from cache...\n")
  s_min_sims <- readRDS(cache_file)
} else {
  cat("Running s_min sensitivity simulations...\n")
  s_min_sims <- lapply(seq_along(s_min_vals), function(i) {
    cat(" s_min =", s_min_vals[i], "... ")
    p   <- modifyList(baseline, list(s_min = s_min_vals[i]))
    hdf <- build_habitat(p)
    res <- run_simulation(hdf, p, wt_growth = wt.growth)
    cat("ends", format(max(res$ibm_long$date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
    res
  })
  names(s_min_sims) <- s_min_labels
  dir.create("cache", showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(s_min_sims, cache_file)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: s_min-outcomes

s_min_census   <- bind_rows(Map(oct1_census,   s_min_sims, s_min_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = s_min_labels))
s_min_sr       <- bind_rows(Map(stock_recruit, s_min_sims, s_min_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = s_min_labels))
s_min_thin     <- bind_rows(Map(thinning_rate, s_min_sims, s_min_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = s_min_labels))
s_min_dg       <- bind_rows(Map(age0_density_growth, s_min_sims, s_min_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = s_min_labels))
s_min_waa      <- bind_rows(Map(wt_at_age, s_min_sims, s_min_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = s_min_labels))
s_min_age0_dly <- bind_rows(Map(age0_daily_wt, s_min_sims, s_min_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = s_min_labels))
s_min_ag       <- bind_rows(Map(age_growth_stats,    s_min_sims, s_min_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = s_min_labels))
s_min_mincond  <- bind_rows(Map(min_condition_by_age, s_min_sims, s_min_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = s_min_labels))
s_min_afr      <- bind_rows(Map(spawn_afr,            s_min_sims, s_min_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = s_min_labels))
s_min_part     <- bind_rows(Map(spawn_participation,  s_min_sims, s_min_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = s_min_labels))
s_min_rec      <- bind_rows(Map(recruit_indices,       s_min_sims, s_min_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = s_min_labels))
s_min_repeat   <- bind_rows(Map(repeat_spawning,       s_min_sims, s_min_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = s_min_labels))
s_min_stable   <- population_stats(s_min_census)
```

## `s_w0`: size-survival inflection weight

`s_w0` is the fish weight (g) at which daily survival is halfway between `s_min` and the
habitat-specific maximum. It defines how long fish remain in the high-mortality zone after
hatching: smaller `s_w0` means fish exit the danger zone sooner; larger `s_w0` prolongs
exposure. Based on visual inspection of age-0 daily weight trajectory plots, ~7g
corresponds to approximately 60 days post-hatch in cold habitat — the ecological basis
for the default. This section tests sensitivity to that assumption.

| Scenario | `s_w0` | Approx. days post-hatch to reach inflection (cold) |
|---|---|---|
| Low | 2g | ~35 days |
| **Baseline** | **5g** | **~60 days** |
| High | 10g | ~90 days |

All other parameters held at baseline.

```{r}
#| label: sim-s_w0
#| cache: false

w0_vals   <- c(2, 5, 10)
w0_labels <- paste0("s_w0 = ", w0_vals, "g")
w0_cols   <- sens_cols

cache_file <- "cache/w0_sims.rds"
if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  cat("Loading s_w0 simulations from cache...\n")
  w0_sims <- readRDS(cache_file)
} else {
  cat("Running s_w0 sensitivity simulations...\n")
  w0_sims <- lapply(seq_along(w0_vals), function(i) {
    cat(" s_w0 =", w0_vals[i], "... ")
    p   <- modifyList(baseline, list(s_w0 = w0_vals[i]))
    hdf <- build_habitat(p)
    res <- run_simulation(hdf, p, wt_growth = wt.growth)
    cat("ends", format(max(res$ibm_long$date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
    res
  })
  names(w0_sims) <- w0_labels
  dir.create("cache", showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(w0_sims, cache_file)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: w0-outcomes

w0_census   <- bind_rows(Map(oct1_census,         w0_sims, w0_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = w0_labels))
w0_sr       <- bind_rows(Map(stock_recruit,       w0_sims, w0_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = w0_labels))
w0_thin     <- bind_rows(Map(thinning_rate,       w0_sims, w0_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = w0_labels))
w0_dg       <- bind_rows(Map(age0_density_growth, w0_sims, w0_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = w0_labels))
w0_waa      <- bind_rows(Map(wt_at_age,           w0_sims, w0_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = w0_labels))
w0_age0_dly <- bind_rows(Map(age0_daily_wt,       w0_sims, w0_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = w0_labels))
w0_ag       <- bind_rows(Map(age_growth_stats,    w0_sims, w0_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = w0_labels))
w0_mincond  <- bind_rows(Map(min_condition_by_age, w0_sims, w0_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = w0_labels))
w0_afr      <- bind_rows(Map(spawn_afr,            w0_sims, w0_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = w0_labels))
w0_part     <- bind_rows(Map(spawn_participation,  w0_sims, w0_labels)) |>
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-w0-comp
#| fig-cap: "Top-left: burn-in population map. Top-right: stock-recruitment. Bottom-left: size-based early thinning (% of fry surviving to day 60). Bottom-right: density–growth relationship. The bottom row together shows the two pathways of size-based density-dependent compensation: cohort thinning (left) and growth suppression (right). p_sr <- ggplot(w0_sr |> filter(spawner_kg > 0),
               aes(x = spawner_kg, y = bio_surv60_kg, color = label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, span = 0.7, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = w0_cols) +
  labs(x = "Spawner biomass (kg)", y = "Fry biomass at 60 days (kg)",
       color = NULL, title = "Stock-recruitment") +
  theme_sens() + theme(legend.position = "right")

p_thin <- ggplot(w0_thin, aes(x = n_born, y = surv_rate, color = label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, span = 0.7, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = w0_cols) +
  labs(x = "Fry born", y = "% of fry surviving to day 60",
       color = NULL, title = "Size-based thinning",
       subtitle = "Larger s_w0 = more time in danger zone = steeper survival decline") +
  theme_sens() + theme(legend.position = "none")

p_dg <- ggplot(w0_dg, aes(x = mean_july_n, y = mean_wt, color = label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(4, 7, 10), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = w0_cols) +
  labs(x = "Mean July N (all fish)", y = "Age-0 weight at Aug 1 (g)", color = NULL,
       title = "Density\u2013growth relationship",
       subtitle = "Dotted lines = s_w0 values; high density pushes cohorts below their own threshold") +
  theme_sens() + theme(legend.position = "none")

(p_map | p_sr) / (p_thin | p_dg)
```

Larger cohorts experience slower growth through food competition, which delays
the date at which mean cohort weight first exceeds `s_w0`. This plot directly
quantifies that effect: the x-axis is cohort size (fry born), the y-axis is
days post-hatch until the burn-in cohort-mean weight trajectory first crosses
`s_w0`. A positive slope confirms that density extends the low-survival window,
and the slope magnitude indicates how many extra days of size-based mortality
each additional 1,000 fry born imposes.

```{r}
#| label: fig-w0-danger-duration
#| fig-cap: "Days post-hatch until the burn-in cohort-mean weight first exceeds s_w0, plotted against cohort size (fry born). Each point is one burn-in cohort year. Lines are OLS fits with 95% CI. The near-identical slopes across s_w0 values indicate that the density-dependent extension of the low-survival window (~20 extra days per 1,000 fry born) is a property of the growth response to density, not the threshold level."
#| fig-height: 5

w0_cross <- bind_rows(Map(days_to_threshold, w0_sims, w0_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = w0_labels))

plot_danger_duration(w0_cross, w0_cols)
```

## `pcmax_cold` / `pcmax_warm`: consumption

`pcmax` sets the fixed daily consumption as a proportion of physiological maximum Cmax. This (fixed-p) configuration effectively assumes that food availability scales with temperature. This assumption has broad support in the literature. Also see TestPValSpecs.qmd for a sensitivity analysis describing alternative methods for configurating consumption.

```{r}
#| label: sim-pcmax
#| cache: false

pcmax_vals   <- c(0.50, 0.60, 0.70)
pcmax_labels <- paste0("pcmax = ", pcmax_vals)
pcmax_cols   <- c("#0072B2", "#009E73", "#D55E00")

cache_file <- "cache/pcmax_sims.rds"
if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  cat("Loading pcmax simulations from cache...\n")
  pcmax_sims <- readRDS(cache_file)
} else {
  cat("Running pcmax sensitivity simulations...\n")
  pcmax_sims <- lapply(seq_along(pcmax_vals), function(i) {
    pv <- pcmax_vals[i]
    cat(" pcmax =", pv, "... ")
    p   <- modifyList(baseline, list(pcmax_cold = pv, pcmax_warm = pv))
    hdf <- build_habitat(p)
    res <- run_simulation(hdf, p, wt_growth = wt.growth)
    cat("ends", format(max(res$ibm_long$date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
    res
  })
  names(pcmax_sims) <- pcmax_labels
  dir.create("cache", showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(pcmax_sims, cache_file)
}
```

---

## `A_cold`: habitat area

`A_cold` sets the area of cold habitat available to fish (in arbitrary area units;
`eff_density = (n - 1) / A_cold`). For the null cold-only scenario, `A_warm = 0`
throughout, and cold habitat declines linearly from `A_cold` to 0 over the 60-year
experiment period regardless of starting area. Larger starting area means a larger
effective carrying capacity during the burn-in and a longer absolute decline before
the population is forced into critically small habitat.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Interaction with K

Increasing `A_cold` is mathematically equivalent to scaling K upward: both reduce
`eff_density` for a given N.  **K and A_cold are partially substitutable**
:::

```{r}
#| label: sim-area
#| cache: false

area_vals   <- c(0.5, 1, 1.5)
area_labels <- paste0("A_cold = ", area_vals)
area_cols   <- c("#0072B2", "#009E73", "#D55E00")

cache_file <- "cache/area_sims.rds"
if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  cat("Loading habitat area simulations from cache...\n")
  area_sims <- readRDS(cache_file)
} else {
  cat("Running habitat area sensitivity simulations...\n")
  area_sims <- lapply(seq_along(area_vals), function(i) {
    av <- area_vals[i]
    cat(" A_cold =", av, "... ")
    # A_cold_target = 0 retained: cold habitat still declines to 0 over experiment.
    # A_warm = 0 retained: null cold-only scenario.
    p   <- modifyList(baseline, list(A_cold = av))
    hdf <- build_habitat(p)
    res <- run_simulation(hdf, p, wt_growth = wt.growth)
    cat("ends", format(max(res$ibm_long$date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
    res
  })
  names(area_sims) <- area_labels
  dir.create("cache", showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(area_sims, cache_file)
}
```

## `K1_starv` / `K9_starv`: condition-based survival inflection

`K1_starv` and `K9_starv` are the condition values at which daily survival probability
is 10% and 90% of the way from `s_min` to `S_max`, respectively. Together they define the
steepness and position of the sigmoid survival–condition curve. The three scenarios tested
span a weak (wide, gentle sigmoid), moderate (baseline), and strong (narrow, steep sigmoid)
condition effect on survival.

| Scenario | `K1_starv` / `K9_starv` | Interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| Weak | 0.45 / 0.55 | Fish only need to lose 50% of mass before severe mortality |
| Moderate | 0.55 / 0.65 | Fish can lose 40% of mass before severe mortality |
| Strong | 0.65 / 0.75 | Fish only need to lose 30% of mass before severe mortality |

```{r}
#| label: sim-starv
#| cache: false

starv_vals   <- list(c(0.5, 0.6), c(0.6, 0.7), c(0.7, 0.8))
starv_labels <- c("K1=0.5 / K9=0.6", "K1=0.6 / K9=0.7", "K1=0.7 / K9=0.8")
starv_cols   <- sens_cols

cache_file <- "cache/starv_sims.rds"
if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  cat("Loading K1_starv/K9_starv simulations from cache...\n")
  starv_sims <- readRDS(cache_file)
} else {
  cat("Running K1_starv/K9_starv sensitivity simulations...\n")
  starv_sims <- lapply(seq_along(starv_vals), function(i) {
    sv <- starv_vals[[i]]
    cat(" K1_starv =", sv[1], ", K9_starv =", sv[2], "... ")
    p   <- modifyList(baseline, list(K1_starv = sv[1], K9_starv = sv[2]))
    hdf <- build_habitat(p)
    res <- run_simulation(hdf, p, wt_growth = wt.growth)
    cat("ends", format(max(res$ibm_long$date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
    res
  })
  names(starv_sims) <- starv_labels
  dir.create("cache", showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(starv_sims, cache_file)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: starv-outcomes

starv_census  <- bind_rows(Map(oct1_census,         starv_sims, starv_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = starv_labels))
starv_sr      <- bind_rows(Map(stock_recruit,       starv_sims, starv_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = starv_labels))
starv_thin    <- bind_rows(Map(thinning_rate,       starv_sims, starv_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = starv_labels))
starv_dg      <- bind_rows(Map(age0_density_growth, starv_sims, starv_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = starv_labels))
starv_waa     <- bind_rows(Map(wt_at_age,           starv_sims, starv_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = starv_labels))
starv_age0_dly <- bind_rows(Map(age0_daily_wt,      starv_sims, starv_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = starv_labels))
starv_ag      <- bind_rows(Map(age_growth_stats,    starv_sims, starv_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = starv_labels))
starv_mincond <- bind_rows(Map(min_condition_by_age, starv_sims, starv_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = starv_labels))
starv_afr     <- bind_rows(Map(spawn_afr,            starv_sims, starv_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = starv_labels))
starv_part    <- bind_rows(Map(spawn_participation,  starv_sims, starv_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = starv_labels))
starv_rec     <- bind_rows(Map(recruit_indices,       starv_sims, starv_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = starv_labels))
starv_repeat  <- bind_rows(Map(repeat_spawning,       starv_sims, starv_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = starv_labels))
starv_stable  <- population_stats(starv_census)
```

## `s_floor_starv`: starvation survival floor

`s_floor_starv` sets the minimum daily survival probability from starvation, acting as a floor on the logistic curve. Without a floor, daily survival approaches zero at very low condition, making condition-based mortality essentially a death sentence once fish fall below K1. A positive floor means even severely depleted fish retain some daily survival probability, with mortality accumulating gradually over days rather than acutely per day. All three scenarios hold `K1_starv = 0.55` and `K9_starv = 0.65` fixed.

| Scenario | `s_floor_starv` | Interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| Low floor | 0.85 | At zero condition, daily survival = 0.85; 30-day survival at nadir ≈ 7–63% |
| Mid floor | 0.90 | At zero condition, daily survival = 0.90; 30-day survival at nadir ≈ 26–74% |
| High floor | 0.95 | At zero condition, daily survival = 0.95; 30-day survival at nadir ≈ 60–86% |

```{r}
#| label: sim-floor
#| cache: false

floor_vals   <- c(0.85, 0.90, 0.95)
floor_labels <- paste0("s_floor = ", floor_vals)
floor_cols   <- sens_cols

cache_file <- "cache/floor_sims.rds"
if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  cat("Loading s_floor_starv simulations from cache...\n")
  floor_sims <- readRDS(cache_file)
} else {
  cat("Running s_floor_starv sensitivity simulations...\n")
  floor_sims <- lapply(seq_along(floor_vals), function(i) {
    cat(" s_floor_starv =", floor_vals[i], "... ")
    p   <- modifyList(baseline, list(K1_starv = 0.6, K9_starv = 0.7,
                                     s_floor_starv = floor_vals[i]))
    hdf <- build_habitat(p)
    res <- run_simulation(hdf, p, wt_growth = wt.growth)
    cat("ends", format(max(res$ibm_long$date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
    res
  })
  names(floor_sims) <- floor_labels
  dir.create("cache", showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(floor_sims, cache_file)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: floor-outcomes

floor_census   <- bind_rows(Map(oct1_census,         floor_sims, floor_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = floor_labels))
floor_sr       <- bind_rows(Map(stock_recruit,       floor_sims, floor_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = floor_labels))
floor_thin     <- bind_rows(Map(thinning_rate,        floor_sims, floor_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = floor_labels))
floor_dg       <- bind_rows(Map(age0_density_growth, floor_sims, floor_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = floor_labels))
floor_waa      <- bind_rows(Map(wt_at_age,           floor_sims, floor_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = floor_labels))
floor_age0_dly <- bind_rows(Map(age0_daily_wt,       floor_sims, floor_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = floor_labels))
floor_ag       <- bind_rows(Map(age_growth_stats,    floor_sims, floor_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = floor_labels))
floor_mincond  <- bind_rows(Map(min_condition_by_age, floor_sims, floor_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = floor_labels))
floor_afr      <- bind_rows(Map(spawn_afr,            floor_sims, floor_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = floor_labels))
floor_part     <- bind_rows(Map(spawn_participation,  floor_sims, floor_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = floor_labels))
floor_rec      <- bind_rows(Map(recruit_indices,       floor_sims, floor_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = floor_labels))
floor_repeat   <- bind_rows(Map(repeat_spawning,       floor_sims, floor_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = floor_labels))
floor_stable   <- population_stats(floor_census)
```

## `S_max_cold`: maximum daily survival probability

`S_max_cold` sets the ceiling on daily survival for fish in optimal condition in cold
habitat. Three values are tested spanning approximately 70%, 80%, and 90% annual survival
for large, healthy fish (assuming ~365 survival opportunities per year).

| Scenario | `S_max_cold` | Approx. annual survival (healthy fish) |
|---|---|---|
| Low | 0.9990 | ~70% |
| **Baseline** | **0.9994** | **~80%** |
| High | 0.9997 | ~90% |

```{r}
#| label: sim-smax
#| cache: false

smax_vals   <- c(0.9990, 0.9994, 0.9997)
smax_labels <- paste0("S_max = ", smax_vals)
smax_cols   <- sens_cols

cache_file <- "cache/smax_sims.rds"
if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  cat("Loading S_max_cold simulations from cache...\n")
  smax_sims <- readRDS(cache_file)
} else {
  cat("Running S_max_cold sensitivity simulations...\n")
  smax_sims <- lapply(seq_along(smax_vals), function(i) {
    sv <- smax_vals[i]
    cat(" S_max_cold =", sv, "... ")
    p   <- modifyList(baseline, list(S_max_cold = sv))
    hdf <- build_habitat(p)
    res <- run_simulation(hdf, p, wt_growth = wt.growth)
    cat("ends", format(max(res$ibm_long$date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
    res
  })
  names(smax_sims) <- smax_labels
  dir.create("cache", showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(smax_sims, cache_file)
}
```

```{r}
smax_sr       <- bind_rows(Map(stock_recruit,       smax_sims, smax_labels)) |>
```

## Cross-parameter summary

```{r}
#| label: fig-cv-summary
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-cap: "Cross-parameter sensitivity summary (experimental period). Rows: years simulated (dashed line = max possible), mean Oct 1 abundance, mean Oct 1 biomass, mean Oct 1 age-0 weight, Q95 age, Q95 weight, mean age at first reproduction, and mean spawning participation. Error bars: ±1 SD across years. Columns: nine parameters tested."

param_levels <- c("K_cold", "egg_surv", "dom_beta", "s_min", "s_w0",
                  "pcmax_cold", "A_cold", "S_cond_inflect", "S_cond_floor", "S_max_cold")
param_labels <- c("K", "egg_surv", "dom. beta\n(pcmax = 0.7)", "s_min", "s_w0",
                  "pcmax", "A_cold", "Surv. cond.\ninflect.", "Surv. cond.\nfloor", "S_max")

# ── Helper: assemble one row per scenario label for a given parameter ─────────
param_summary <- function(stable, age0_dly, ag, afr, part, census, `repeat`, param_name) {
  age0_oct1 <- age0_dly |>
    filter(month(date) == 10, day(date) == 1) |>
    select(-c("date", "n")) |>
    rename("mean_age0_wt" = "mean_wt", "sd_age0_wt" = "sd_wt") 

  # Anchor on ALL labels from the census (includes collapsed scenarios).
  # Experimental-period metrics will be NA for scenarios that collapse early.
  total_sim_yrs(census) |>
    left_join(stable |> filter(phase == "experiment") |>
                select(label, mean_N, sd_N, mean_bio, sd_bio),
              by = "label") |>
    left_join(age0_oct1,                                  by = "label") |>
    left_join(ag   |> select(label, q95_age, q95_wt),    by = "label") |>
    left_join(afr  |> select(label, mean_afr, sd_afr),   by = "label") |>
    left_join(part |> select(label, mean_part, sd_part),  by = "label") |>
    left_join(`repeat` |> select(label, mean_pct_repeat, sd_pct_repeat),  by = "label") |>
    mutate(parameter = param_name)
}

cross_all <- bind_rows(
  param_summary(K_stable,     K_age0_dly,     K_ag,     K_afr,     K_part,     K_census,     K_repeat,     "K_cold"),
  param_summary(egg_stable,   egg_age0_dly,   egg_ag,   egg_afr,   egg_part,   egg_census,   egg_repeat,   "egg_surv"),
  param_summary(beta_stable,  beta_age0_dly,  beta_ag,  beta_afr,  beta_part,  beta_census,  beta_repeat,  "dom_beta"),
  param_summary(s_min_stable, s_min_age0_dly, s_min_ag, s_min_afr, s_min_part, s_min_census, s_min_repeat, "s_min"),
  param_summary(w0_stable,    w0_age0_dly,    w0_ag,    w0_afr,    w0_part,    w0_census,    w0_repeat,    "s_w0"),
  param_summary(pcmax_stable, pcmax_age0_dly, pcmax_ag, pcmax_afr, pcmax_part, pcmax_census, pcmax_repeat, "pcmax_cold"),
  param_summary(area_stable,  area_age0_dly,  area_ag,  area_afr,  area_part,  area_census,  area_repeat,  "A_cold"),
  param_summary(starv_stable, starv_age0_dly, starv_ag, starv_afr, starv_part, starv_census, starv_repeat, "S_cond_inflect"),
  param_summary(floor_stable, floor_age0_dly, floor_ag, floor_afr, floor_part, floor_census, floor_repeat, "S_cond_floor"),
  param_summary(smax_stable,  smax_age0_dly,  smax_ag,  smax_afr,  smax_part,  smax_census,  smax_repeat,  "S_max_cold")
)

# ── Pivot to long format with matched SD column ───────────────────────────────
cross_long <- cross_all |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(total_yrs, mean_N, mean_bio, mean_age0_wt,
                  q95_age, q95_wt, mean_afr, mean_part, mean_pct_repeat),
    names_to  = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sd = case_when(
      metric == "mean_N"          ~ sd_N,
      metric == "mean_bio"        ~ sd_bio,
      metric == "mean_age0_wt"    ~ sd_age0_wt,
      metric == "mean_afr"        ~ sd_afr,
      metric == "mean_part"       ~ sd_part,
      metric == "mean_pct_repeat" ~ sd_pct_repeat,
      TRUE                        ~ NA_real_
    ),
    metric = factor(metric,
                    levels = c("total_yrs", "mean_N", "mean_bio", "mean_age0_wt",
                               "q95_age", "q95_wt", "mean_afr", "mean_part", "mean_pct_repeat"),
                    labels = c("Years simulated", "N (Oct 1)", "Biomass (kg, Oct. 1)",
                               "Age-0 wt (g, Oct. 1)", "Q95 age (yr)", "Q95 weight (g)",
                               "Age at 1st repro. (yr)", "Spawning participation", "Repeat spawning (%)")),
    parameter = factor(parameter, levels = param_levels, labels = param_labels)
  )

# ── 10-color palette (Okabe-Ito extended) ────────────────────────────────────
param_fill <- c("#0072B2", "#009E73", "#D55E00", "#E69F00", "#56B4E9",
                "#CC79A7", "#999999", "#F0E442", "#8B4513", "#1B7837")
names(param_fill) <- param_labels

max_sim_yrs <- baseline$nyears_burnin + baseline$nyears_experiment

ggplot(cross_long, aes(x = label, y = value, fill = parameter)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = value - sd, ymax = value + sd),
                width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(
    data = \(d) filter(d, metric == "Years simulated"),
    aes(yintercept = max_sim_yrs),
    linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ parameter, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = param_fill) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Cross-parameter sensitivity summary — experimental period",
       subtitle = paste0("Error bars: \u00b11 SD across years.  ",
                         "Dashed line (years simulated panel): maximum possible years.")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey88"),
        strip.text.x     = element_text(size = 7.5),
        strip.text.y     = element_text(size = 7, lineheight = 0.85),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 5.5, lineheight = 0.8,
                                        angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        plot.title       = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 7.5, color = "grey30"),
        panel.spacing    = unit(0.5, "lines"))
```



## Final tune

This section runs a single candidate parameterization that combines adjustments identified during the sensitivity analysis: 

- `K_cold = 400`, `K_warm = 400`
- `egg_surv = 0.15`
- `dominance_beta = 0.5`
- `s_min = 0.96`
- `s_w0 = 5`
- `pcmax_cold = 0.5`, `pcmax_warm = 0.5`
- `A_cold = 1.0`, `A_warm = 0.0`
- `K1_starv = 0.6`, `K9_starv = 0.7`
- `S_max_cold = 0.9994`, `S_max_warm = 0.9994`

All other parameters are held at their baseline values. The purpose is to assess whether this combination produces acceptable burn-in dynamics and compensatory regulation before committing to it as the working parameterization for scenario runs.

```{r}
#| label: sim-final
#| cache: false

p <- modifyList(baseline, list(K_cold = 400, K_warm = 400,
                               egg_surv = 0.15,
                               dominance_beta = 0.5,
                               s_min = 0.96,
                               s_w0 = 5,
                               pcmax_cold = 0.5, pcmax_warm = 0.5,
                               A_cold = 1.0, A_warm = 0.0,
                               K1_starv = 0.60, K9_starv = 0.70,
                               s_floor_starv = 0.9,
                               S_max_cold = 0.9994, S_max_warm = 0.9994))

cache_file <- "cache/final_sims.rds"
if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
  cat("Loading final tune simulation from cache...\n")
  final_sims <- readRDS(cache_file)
} else {
  cat("Running final tune simulation...\n")
  hdf        <- build_habitat(p)
  final_sims <- run_simulation(hdf, p, wt_growth = wt.growth)
  cat("ends", format(max(final_sims$ibm_long$date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
  dir.create("cache", showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(final_sims, cache_file)
}

final_sims <- list(final_sims)
```

```{r}
#| label: final-outcomes

final_labels   <- c("Final set")
final_cols      <- c("Final set" = "#009E73")

final_census   <- bind_rows(Map(oct1_census,   final_sims, final_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = final_labels))
final_sr       <- bind_rows(Map(stock_recruit, final_sims, final_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = final_labels))
final_thin     <- bind_rows(Map(thinning_rate,        final_sims, final_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = final_labels))
final_dg       <- bind_rows(Map(age0_density_growth, final_sims, final_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = final_labels))
final_waa      <- bind_rows(Map(wt_at_age,     final_sims, final_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = final_labels))
final_age0_dly <- bind_rows(Map(age0_daily_wt, final_sims, final_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = final_labels))
final_ag       <- bind_rows(Map(age_growth_stats,    final_sims, final_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = final_labels))
final_mincond  <- bind_rows(Map(min_condition_by_age, final_sims, final_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = final_labels))
final_afr      <- bind_rows(Map(spawn_afr,            final_sims, final_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = final_labels))
final_part     <- bind_rows(Map(spawn_participation,  final_sims, final_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = final_labels))
final_rec      <- bind_rows(Map(recruit_indices,       final_sims, final_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = final_labels))
final_repeat   <- bind_rows(Map(repeat_spawning,       final_sims, final_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = final_labels))
final_stable   <- population_stats(final_census)
```

### Compensatory dynamics

```{r}
#| label: fig-final-comp
#| fig-cap: "Top-left: burn-in population map. Top-right: stock-recruitment. Bottom-left: size-based early thinning (% of fry surviving to day 60). Bottom-right: density–growth relationship. The bottom row together shows the two pathways of size-based density-dependent compensation: cohort thinning (left) and growth suppression (right)."
#| fig-height: 8

final_map <- pop_map(final_census)

p_map <- ggplot(final_map, aes(x = N, y = N_next, color = label)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, span = 0.75, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = final_cols) +
  labs(x = "N (year t, Oct 1)", y = "N (year t+1, Oct 1)", color = NULL,
       title = "Population map (burn-in)") +
  theme_sens() + theme(legend.position = "none")

p_sr <- ggplot(final_sr |> filter(spawner_kg > 0),
               aes(x = spawner_kg, y = bio_surv60_kg, color = label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, span = 0.7, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = final_cols) +
  labs(x = "Spawner biomass (kg)", y = "Fry biomass at 60 days (kg)", color = NULL,
       title = "Stock-recruitment") +
  theme_sens() + theme(legend.position = "right")

p_thin <- ggplot(final_thin, aes(x = n_born, y = surv_rate, color = label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, span = 0.7, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = final_cols) +
  labs(x = "Fry born", y = "% of fry surviving to day 60",
       color = NULL, title = "Size-based thinning",
       subtitle = "Larger final = lower eff_density = weaker thinning (same interaction as high K)") +
  theme_sens() + theme(legend.position = "none")

p_dg <- ggplot(final_dg, aes(x = mean_july_n, y = mean_wt, color = label)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 7, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  scale_color_manual(values = final_cols) +
  labs(x = "Mean July N (all fish)", y = "Age-0 weight at Aug 1 (g)", color = NULL,
       title = "Density\u2013growth relationship",
       subtitle = "Higher density = slower early growth = more time below w\u2080") +
  theme_sens() + theme(legend.position = "none")

(p_map | p_sr) / (p_thin | p_dg)
```
